stories.start_quote: האיש הה"ק מלובלין זצ״ל האיש הדופק בפתח
stories.summary_en: The Seer of Lublin praises R. Zvi Hirsch of Zhidachov, who stands knocking at his door, as one of three disciples who never forget the fear of God, then admits him; when Zhidachov asks about buying a house, the Seer says he should buy one only in Jerusalem; the visiting rabbi R"L objects from Maimonides, is overwhelmed by the pilpul between the Seer and Zhidachov, and recognizes their greatness, yet he ignores the Seer's advice, hoards his wax and honey, and loses his fortune as foretold.
